blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Small talk is the art of short, friendly conversations. You use it at the coffee machine, in the lift, or before a meeting. It is quick and easy.

Small talk breaks the ice. It helps you build bonds with your colleagues. You do not need long sentences. A few simple phrases are enough.

Today you learn 5 easy phrases. You can ask "How was your weekend?" or say "Nice weather today!" Step by step, you can do it. Remember: English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts.

items.q: What is small talk?
items.why: "Small talk is the art of short, friendly conversations."

items.q: Where do you use small talk?
options: At the coffee machine, in the lift, or before a meeting
items.why: "You use it at the coffee machine, in the lift, or before a meeting."

items.q: What does small talk help you do?
items.why: "It helps you build bonds with your colleagues."

items.q: The text suggests that small talk is…
options: a waste of time at work
very difficult and only for experts
easy, because you only need a few simple phrases
items.why: Inferência: "You do not need long sentences. A few simple phrases are enough." — logo, é fácil.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "A short chat can help you connect with people."
"You need perfect English to make small talk."
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "English comes in CAN's" e que frases simples bastam — não é preciso inglês perfeito.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie na máquina de café. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Oh, hi Tom! Good morning. Do you want a coffee? The machine is free now.

How was your weekend? Mine was very nice. I stayed at home and I read a book. The weather was good, so I walked in the park with my dog. And you? Did you do anything fun?

It is a busy day today, isn't it? I have three meetings this morning. But I need my coffee first! I am always slow before my coffee.

Nice weather today, look — the sun is out. Maybe we can have lunch outside later. Let's chat again at lunch, okay?

Oh, my coffee is ready. I have to go now. It was nice to talk to you, Tom. Have a good day! See you at the coffee machine tomorrow.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What did Sophie do on the weekend?
options: She stayed home, read a book, and walked in the park
items.why: "I stayed at home and I read a book… I walked in the park with my dog."

items.q: How many meetings does Sophie have this morning?
items.why: "I have three meetings this morning."

items.q: What does Sophie want to do at lunch?
options: Have lunch outside and chat again
items.why: "Maybe we can have lunch outside later. Let's chat again at lunch."

items.q: "I am always slow before my coffee." This suggests that Sophie…
options: feels more awake after her coffee
items.why: Inferência: se ela é lenta antes do café, o café a deixa mais desperta depois.

items.q: How would you describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela cumprimenta, oferece café e faz planos — um tom amigável e leve.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "How was your weekend?" A weekend is…
items.why: Weekend = fim de semana (sábado e domingo).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I have many meetings today. I am very ___."
items.why: Busy = ocupado; combina com "many meetings today".

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The sun is out and it is warm. The ___ is nice today."
items.why: Weather = clima; sol e calor descrevem o clima.

items.q: "Do you want a coffee?" A coffee is…
items.why: Coffee = café, uma bebida quente.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Let's have a quick ___ at the coffee machine."
items.why: Chat = bate-papo, uma conversa curta e informal.

blocks.instruction: Expressões úteis para conversas curtas no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "A friendly hello can break the ice." To break the ice means to…
items.why: Break the ice = quebrar o gelo, começar uma conversa e deixar as pessoas à vontade.

items.q: "How are things? — Not bad, thanks." "Not bad" means…
items.why: "Not bad" = tudo bem / razoavelmente bom; é uma resposta positiva e comum.

items.q: "Fancy a coffee?" This means…
items.why: "Fancy a…?" = Você quer/topa um…? É um convite informal.

items.q: "I'm busy now. Let's catch up later." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar o papo em dia, conversar e trocar novidades depois.

items.q: "Have a good weekend!" You say this…
options: in the middle of a meeting
items.why: "Have a good weekend!" = Bom fim de semana! — dito na sexta, antes do fim de semana.
